data.title: Finding the Jump Size!
data.description: Discover the secret skip value by watching the friendly rabbit hop along the number line.

character.imagePrompt: A cute cheerful rabbit ready to make regular hops along a number line.

challenges.instruction: Look at where it lands. How far is each jump?
challenges.hint: Find the difference between two landings next to each other.
challenges.narration: Can you figure out how far each jump goes?

challenges.instruction: Watch the hops along the line. Can you figure out the skip value for this path?
challenges.hint: Find the difference between two landings next to each other.
challenges.narration: Keep counting along with the bouncing rabbit!

challenges.instruction: Inspect the jump intervals from 0 up to 8. What is the skip value?
challenges.hint: Find the difference between two landings next to each other.
challenges.narration: Every single jump is the exact same size!

challenges.instruction: Observe the pattern on the number line ending at 10. What is the hidden skip value?
challenges.hint: Find the difference between two landings next to each other.
challenges.narration: You are becoming a number line expert!

challenges.instruction: Final challenge! Look at all the jumps shown on the line. What is the skip value?
challenges.hint: Find the difference between two landings next to each other.
challenges.narration: Fantastic job discovering the skip values!
